task.title: To make an inserted field read-only

step.cmd: Open a template in X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab and click Fields. This displays the Repeat Section (object name) and the fields in the repeat section.
Enter the field name in the Search Field and click the search icon ().
Click the Settings icon () next to the selected field name to open the Field Settings page.
Toggle the Readnly switch to on.
